profile.name: Bimo机器人套件
profile.description: Bimo 是一套小型腿式机器人实验平台，配有舵机驱动关节、惯性测量单元、多个方向的测距传感器以及摄像头，并通过主控板进行通信控制。它适用于机器人教学与实验中的姿态估计、运动控制、关节校准、避障感知和视觉数据采集。
profile.description_en: Bimo is a compact legged robotics platform with servo-actuated joints, an IMU, multi-direction distance sensors, and onboard cameras, controlled through an MCU. It is used in robotics teaching and laboratory work for posture estimation, motion control, joint calibration, obstacle sensing, and vision data acquisition.
